_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for operator identity. Whoever signs and ships this app edits
THIS file, then runs `node ops/gen-wellknown.mjs --write` and `node ops/check-branding.mjs`.
Full runbook: ops/REBRAND.md. Rationale: backlog/decisions/ (configuration-surface record).
The defaults below are the values the live deployment already serves. Changing any of
them changes a file that gates PHYSICAL NFC TAGS: get one wrong and every tap opens a
browser instead of the app, which is only fixable by walking to every building.
host                          the tag URI host, https://<host>/t?l=<uuid> (decision-5, d21).
MUST be the host that actually serves the two well-known
files, with no redirect and no CDN alias, and MUST match the
app's Associated Domains entitlement (decision-4).
apple.teamId                  10-char Apple Developer Team ID.
apple.bundleIds               APPEND-ONLY. Apple caches AASA and installed apps hold their
association until reinstall. Removing an id bricks every
installed copy of that app; the generator refuses unless you
pass --allow-removal.
apple.paths                   AASA path patterns. Widening this hands more of the site to
the app; /t* is the whole tag surface.
android.packageName           Play applicationId. IMMUTABLE after the first Play upload.
android.sha256CertFingerprints
PLURAL, and this is where Android App Links die. With Play
App Signing on (the default) the UPLOAD key and the PLAY
SIGNING key are different certificates and BOTH must be
listed. Take the Play one from Play Console > Release >
Setup > App signing - NEVER from keytool, which only ever
knows your local key. Add the debug keystore fingerprint too
if you want ./gradlew installDebug to verify.
Format is enforced: uppercase, colon-separated, 32 bytes.
A lowercase fingerprint is valid JSON and is silently
IGNORED by Android - the exact failure this validation exists
to stop. Empty is legal and means: App Links unverified.
NOT in this file on purpose: the app key (API.swift / /etc/nfc/env - a credential, not an
identity, and a third copy would only be a third thing to desync) and the Sentry DSN
(per-project, optional, decision-23).
